title: Feng Cang Falls
summary: Lin Dong faces Feng Cang's Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal with the Green Heaven Materialized Dragon Skill's scale shield and Immovable Bell, then kills him. He takes the seal and Feng Cang's Nirvana Seal and jumps from the Earth tier to the Heaven tier. Super Sect elders, among them Liu Tong of the Yuan Gate and Wu Dao of the Dao Sect, take notice. Qin Tian of the Tianyuan Dynasty, first in the Heaven tier, gives the injured Lin Dong medicine and warns him about the Three Song Devils. Su Rou joins the group, and Lin Dong hides in a cave to heal and break through. A Death Spirit General from the Western Xuan Region attacks to silence them, and Little Mink and Little Flame hold him off. Su Rou opens her inheritance's second seal to protect Lin Dong, who comes out and strikes with the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal.
events: Lin Dong blocks the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal with the Green Dragon scale shield and Immovable Bell.
Lin Dong kills Feng Cang and takes the seal and his Nirvana Seal.
Lin Dong rises to the Heaven tier; Super Sect elders watch.
Su Rou offers her seals in thanks and joins Lin Dong, Lin Diao and Lin Yan.
Qin Tian gives Lin Dong medicine and promises to fight him on Baichao Mountain.
A Death Spirit General of the Western Xuan Region attacks while Lin Dong breaks through in a cave.
Su Rou opens her inheritance's second seal to defend Lin Dong.
Lin Dong comes out and uses the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal on the attackers.
cultivation: Lin Dong is Three Yuan Nirvana. Qin Tian is Six Yuan Nirvana. The Death Spirit General is Five Yuan Nirvana. Su Rou can now bear two layers of her inheritance's seals. Lin Dong's breakthrough attempt in the cave is cut short.
